scope: Observed browser interactions; lending fixture supplies broker and borrower. Not external customer research.
observed: Separate faucet-funded seller and buyer browser sessions with different addresses; wallets restored after reload.
Seller deposits 100 test XRP through Position.
100 XRP withdrawal is refused with shares unchanged and 50 XRP available.
Seller publishes 100000000 raw share units for 95 XRP; the buyer opens the same shared offer.
Buyer authorizes the issuance and signs payment; the seller approves and submits from their own session.
Buyer uses read-only Check recorded transaction to verify both exchange legs.
After fixture repayment, buyer withdraws 100.00024 test XRP through Position; final vault assets and share supply are zero.
Publishing keeps the button disabled without displaying a spurious network-paused alert.
Production server stopped and restarted with the same SQLite database while the attempt was pending.
Buyer reload restored the same attempt and hash; Check recorded transaction verified both exchange legs without rebroadcast.

Browser fixture stopped before repayment because RPC presentation fields failed its strict Batch field check. Read-only verification of the same hash passed after stripping ctid, date and ledger_index. A distinct vault fixture was started to complete the full journey; the original trade was never resent.
